data.one_liner: Open a URL with the system's default application on Dart VM platforms.
data.what_it_does: Calls the OS utility (start, xdg-open, open) to launch a URL in the default handler. Works on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux when running on the Dart VM. Not usable in Flutter projects, which should use url_launcher instead.
use_when: Running pure Dart code on the VM and need to open a web page or file with the default system app
You need a lightweight solution without pulling in Flutter dependencies
avoid_when: Needing advanced features like checking if a URL can be launched
strengths: Works on all major desktop platforms
weaknesses: Only works on Dart VM, not in Flutter or web
No ability to check launch availability

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the same functionality for Flutter apps and supports web, with additional launch checks
